title: ReversSecurity MC Plugin
description: Staff plugin for Minecraft servers with moderation tools, security features, and hack detection.
body:
ReversSecurity ︱ Advanced Server Anti-Exploit & Crash Protection

Keep your server online, stable, and immune to malicious attacks. ReversSecurity is an enterprise-grade security plugin developed by Revers Studio. Designed specifically to counter the most aggressive server crashers, exploit clients, and packet-manipulation tools, this plugin acts as an intelligent firewall for your Minecraft server. It intercepts malicious payloads before they can exploit vulnerabilities, ensuring your server maintains a perfect 20 TPS even under heavy targeted attacks.

⚠️ IMPORTANT FOR MODERATORS & USERS:
Please check the visual section below to see real in-game screenshots, config layouts, and live exploit mitigation.

❱ KEY FEATURES IN DEPTH:

🛡️ Packet Manipulation Defenses:
Block exploit clients from flooding your server with oversized, malformed, or corrupted packets. ReversSecurity actively filters incoming network traffic, instantly dropping invalid packets before they can cause internal memory leaks or complete thread freezes.

🚫 Absolute Exploit Mitigation:
Fully patches dangerous vanilla and modified exploits related to broken NBT data, illegal item positions, payload overflows, and crash-commands. Your server is shielded against modern client-side exploits used to disrupt gameplay.

⚙️ Intelligent Auto-Punish System:
Instantly detect when a user is deliberately attempting to exploit or crash the server. The plugin can be configured to execute automated actions—such as silent alerts for staff, logging events, kicking the offender, or executing permanent IP bans.

🚀 Ultra-Lightweight Network Firewall:
Performance is our top priority. ReversSecurity operates at a low-level packet-interception tier. It consumes virtually zero CPU or RAM overhead, making it perfectly suited for high-population game networks, Factions, Skyblock, and multi-proxy environments.

📊 Live Security Logs & Alerts:
Stay informed about potential threats. Administrators and staff members receive real-time, customizable chat alerts whenever an exploit attempt is successfully neutralized. All events are meticulously logged with precise details for future review.

❱ WHY CHOOSE REVERSSECURITY?

Downtime Prevention: Avoid sudden server crashes that frustrate your players, damage your database files, and ruin your server's ranking.

Proactive Security: Instead of waiting for a crash to happen, ReversSecurity monitors packet rates to stop attacks before they execute.

Revers Studio Quality: Developed under clean coding standards, guaranteeing constant optimization and zero background performance leaks.
